description: This file defines a GatewaySession class for managing WebSocket connections to a gateway, including connection handling, request/response processing, event handling, and authentication logic. It also includes related data classes and utility functions.

classes.name: GatewaySession
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connection lifecycle, request/response handling, event processing, and authentication for gateway communication.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to invoke a node command via the gateway.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an invoke request, including success status, payload, and error info.

classes.name: GatewaySession.ErrorShape
classes.description: Details about an error response from the gateway.

classes.name: RpcResponse
classes.description: Internal data class representing a response to an RPC request.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Handles individual WebSocket connection, message sending/receiving, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: DesiredConnection
classes.description: Holds desired connection parameters for establishing a connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection to the gateway with specified parameters.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the current connection and cleans up state.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect by closing the current connection.

methods.name: sendNodeEvent
methods.description: Sends an event to the node via the gateway.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request to the gateway and awaits a response.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests a refresh of the node's canvas capability.

methods.name: connectOnce
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection and manages the connection lifecycle.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrl
methods.description: Normalizes and constructs the canvas host URL based on raw input and connection parameters.

methods.name: buildCanvasUrl
methods.description: Builds a full URL for the canvas host.

methods.name: buildUrlSuffix
methods.description: Constructs URL suffix from URI components.

methods.name: selectConnectAuth
methods.description: Determines the authentication method to use for connection.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithStoredDeviceToken
methods.description: Decides if a retry with stored device token is appropriate based on error details.

methods.name: shouldPauseReconnectAfterAuthFailure
methods.description: Determines if reconnection should be paused after certain auth failures.

methods.name: shouldClearStoredDeviceTokenAfterRetry
methods.description: Checks if stored device token should be cleared after a retry failure.

methods.name: isTrustedDeviceRetryEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint is trusted for device retry.

methods.name: buildGatewayWebSocketUrl
methods.description: Constructs WebSocket URL for gateway connection.

methods.name: formatGatewayAuthority
methods.description: Formats the authority part of the gateway URL.

methods.name: formatGatewayAuthorityHost
methods.description: Normalizes the host part of the gateway authority.

methods.name: parseJsonOrNull
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonElement or returns null on failure.

methods.name: replaceCanvasCapabilityInScopedHostUrl
methods.description: Replaces the canvas capability segment in a scoped URL.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the acknowledgment timeout for invoke results within bounds.
